columns.name: step_key
columns.meaning: The row's identity: chunk_id/epoch, or chunk_id/epoch/gate/decision_id for a gate step

columns.name: trace_id
columns.meaning: The step's derived trace id, as 32 hex characters, so a row joins to its trace

columns.name: step_kind
columns.meaning: runner, hub or gate

columns.name: chunk_id
columns.meaning: The chunk

columns.name: work_refs
columns.meaning: Its work items as source-native tokens; empty when it has none

columns.name: sources
columns.meaning: The distinct work sources of those items

columns.name: graph_id
columns.meaning: The graph the step stood in

columns.name: graph_name
columns.meaning: The graph's name

columns.name: node_id
columns.meaning: The node

columns.name: node_name
columns.meaning: The node's name

columns.name: epoch
columns.meaning: The epoch

columns.name: decision_id
columns.meaning: A gate step's decision; null otherwise

columns.name: visit
columns.meaning: Which arrival at this node this is, counting from 1

columns.name: runner_id
columns.meaning: The runner that held a runner step; null for hub and gate steps

columns.name: harness_id
columns.meaning: The harness of the step's last invocation

columns.name: models
columns.meaning: Distinct models across its invocations

columns.name: started_at
columns.meaning: When the step started

columns.name: ended_at
columns.meaning: When the step ended; a gate ends at resolved_at when resolved

columns.name: closed_at
columns.meaning: When the closing fact was recorded; equal to ended_at except for a resolved gate

columns.name: duration_ms
columns.meaning: ended_at minus started_at

columns.name: outcome
columns.meaning: How the step ended

columns.name: choice
columns.meaning: The resolved choice, when there is one

columns.name: to_node_name
columns.meaning: Where it led: a node name, done, or graph:<name>

columns.name: preceded_by
columns.meaning: restart, requeue or released-claim

columns.name: bounce_cause
columns.meaning: conflict, checks, master-moved, poll-timeout, or a choice

columns.name: asks
columns.meaning: Asks raised in the step

columns.name: asks_unanswered
columns.meaning: How many asks were never answered

columns.name: wait_queue_ms
columns.meaning: Queue wait, summed

columns.name: wait_claim_ms
columns.meaning: Claim wait, summed

columns.name: wait_ask_ms
columns.meaning: Ask wait, summed

columns.name: wait_pause_ms
columns.meaning: Pause wait, summed

columns.name: wait_pickup_ms
columns.meaning: Decision pickup wait, summed

columns.name: invocations
columns.meaning: How many invocations rows belong to the step

columns.name: input_tokens
columns.meaning: Summed across its invocations, with blizzard's uncached input count

columns.name: output_tokens
columns.meaning: Summed across its invocations

columns.name: cache_read_tokens
columns.meaning: Summed across its invocations

columns.name: cache_create_tokens
columns.meaning: Summed across its invocations

columns.name: cost_billed_usd
columns.meaning: The harness-billed cost, summed; null when no invocation carried one

columns.name: cost_estimated_usd
columns.meaning: The estimated cost, summed; null when no invocation carried one

columns.name: cost_partial
columns.meaning: Some invocation carried neither a billed nor an estimated cost

columns.name: billed_partial
columns.meaning: Some invocation carried no billed cost

columns.name: exported_at
columns.meaning: When this copy of the row was written
